quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical Components and Devices, H1 FY2026 (management's analysis): the submarine-cable market was strong as several large projects started and the number of cable-laying ships increased, and technical change such as more fiber pairs and multicore fiber accelerated. Compact isolator sales rose with new projects and higher fiber-pair counts; at some customers a temporary inventory adjustment in the first part of the half, from switching to new products, gave way to recovering sales later. Sales of optical components such as Faraday rotators rose with the AI server and data-center market, and the company expanded its production capacity for optical components for data centers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lead Terminals, H1 FY2026 (management's analysis): sales to AI servers and the data-center market grew gradually as hybrid and conductive-polymer capacitors are increasingly adopted, raising inquiries and adoption for its leakage-current and low-resistance lead terminals. Prices of aluminum and copper rose; the company passes material price changes into selling prices automatically every three months under a price formula, but the half was temporarily affected by the sharp rise in early 2026. It expanded capacity at the Dongguan (China) plant and widened the product range made at the Malaysia plant.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kohoku Kogyo semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New businesses, H1 FY2026 (semi-annual report): inquiries for SSG high-purity quartz glass parts for semiconductor applications and specialty optical fiber preforms increased significantly, and the company added manufacturing equipment to expand capacity; it began sample shipments of single-crystal PLZT (lead lanthanum zirconate titanate) thin-film wafers as a next-generation high-speed communication device material and presented optical-modulator results at an international conference; it is developing high-power optical isolators for satellite communications.
